blocks.text: Every person who violates any of the provisions of this chapter shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and shall be punished by a fine of not more than $500.00. Each day any violation of this chapter continues shall constitute a separate offense. (Ord. 18181 § 12, 3-2-04. Code 1995 § 30-460.)
